issues.explanation: No test files are included in the diff despite new login, register, logout, password-reset and verification flows requiring Pest/PHPUnit coverage including unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
Livewire components use inline $this->validate([...]) instead of the required #[Validate] attributes plus $this->validate() pattern.
Password reset validates three fields inline with $request->validate instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Verification resend flashes raw verification-link-sent instead of a translated status string while the view renders session status directly.
Register hits the rate limiter before validation and never clears it, so validation failures consume the 5-attempt budget and success does not reset it.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:219 and app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:308 use $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attributes; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:130 uses inline validate for 3 fields

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:40-58 small focused methods, clear names; resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:858-900 consistent Bulma markup, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:225-237 auth.failed/auth.throttle/regenerate/redirectIntended; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:314-326 create+Registered+login; routes/web.php:1086-1113 all contract names/methods; lang/pt_BR/ui.php:493-500 Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu a senha?

scope.evidence: All hunks serve auth/localization: routes, controllers, Livewire, views, lang/en/ui.php + lang/pt_BR/ui.php, .env.example, phpunit.xml locale pins; welcome/bulma-test edits only add route() and __() per task

security.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationController.php:55 EmailVerificationRequest enforces id/hash auth (403 on tamper); app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:139-144 rotates remember_token + fires PasswordReset; all views use {{ }} and route()

simplicity.evidence: Thin controllers, minimal Livewire actions reusing Auth/Password/RateLimiter/Password::defaults in AppServiceProvider.php:372; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ or Pest files; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for Login::submit or Register::submit

review.summary: Implements the full session-auth flow with correct routes, throttling, localization and session handling, but ships no tests and ignores the required #[Validate] Livewire pattern, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
